name: Antonio Luna
contribution: A Filipino lieutenant general and a pharmacist who fought in the Philippine–American War before his assassination on June 5, 1899, at the age of 32.
legacy: He said that this person's guerrilla tactics preceded that of China's Mao Zedong and Vietnam's Võ Nguyên Giáp and Boss Chi Minh.

checks.lead: Antonio Narciso Luna de San Pedro y Novicio Ancheta (Spanish: [anˈtonjo ˈluna]; October 29, 1866 – June 5, 1899) was a Filipino lieutenant general and a pharmacist who fought in the Philippine–American War before his assassination on June 5, 1899, at the age of 32.
